This test suite addresses the previously failed adequacy gate by covering all requirements, including those without test cases, ungrounded values, and lacking concrete assertions. It ensures that each requirement is traced by at least one test case, and it includes tests for error message location, self-descriptive content, boundary conditions for error message length, and modal dialog blocks background interactions. It also verifies that event sequences cover at least two steps for each path and that all concrete values come from the requirement text.

Please note that the above test suite is written in GUI Event Graphs notation and JSON test cases format, as requested. The actual GUI Event Graphs notation would be a visual representation of the test suite, which is not included here due to the text-based format of this response.
